events.name: SET_MODE
events.description: Mode + caret instruction for the editor surface (bar | block). Also the fact a realization reads to drive a mode indicator.

events.name: MOTION
events.description: Move the caret (or extend the selection in VISUAL) by a closed motion name, `count` times.

events.name: OPERATE
events.description: Apply a config-declared operator (delete | yank | change | put | put-before | undo | redo | join | toggle-case | indent | dedent | replace) over the range a motion describes; `line` for doubled operators, `selection` in VISUAL, and a fixed `right` placeholder for the point operators (put | put-before | undo | redo) which the editor ignores.

events.name: INSERT_TEXT
events.description: Insert literal text at the caret (e.g. the newline `o`/`O` insert before entering INSERT, or the replacement char `r` inserts).

events.name: EX_COMMAND
events.description: A buffered ':' line resolved through config.exCommands. `name` is a neutral config-declared string; a realization maps it onto its host's command vocabulary.

events.name: KEY
events.description: One physical keydown, delivered by the host's keyboard router. The host decides preventDefault from config.keymap; this trait only reads key + editorId.

events.name: EDITOR_FOCUS
events.description: The host focused a different editor surface. Every state re-emits its own SET_MODE so the newly focused editor's mode indicator and caret style start correct.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Enter INSERT after the caret
overridableConfigKeys.description: Key that nudges the caret one column right, then switches to INSERT.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Enter INSERT at end of line
overridableConfigKeys.description: Key that moves to line end and past it, then switches to INSERT — vim's `A`.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Enter COMMAND
overridableConfigKeys.description: Key that switches NORMAL to COMMAND and starts buffering an ex-command line.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Delete char before caret
overridableConfigKeys.description: Key that deletes the character(s) to the left of the caret, count times.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Delete char under caret
overridableConfigKeys.description: Key that deletes the character(s) to the right of the caret, count times.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Count digits
overridableConfigKeys.description: Digit keys accumulated into a repeat count before a motion or operator fires (also inside OPERATOR_PENDING, e.g. `d3w`); each digit's integer value is a lookup because the language has no string-to-int operator.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Ex-commands
overridableConfigKeys.description: Buffered COMMAND-mode lines (typed after ':') mapped to a neutral command name carried on EX_COMMAND.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Goto prefix
overridableConfigKeys.description: Arms OPERATOR_PENDING with the `goto` pseudo-operator; pressed again (`gg`) moves to the document start. Any other key cancels back to NORMAL.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Enter INSERT before the caret
overridableConfigKeys.description: Key that switches NORMAL to INSERT with the caret unchanged.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Enter INSERT at first non-blank
overridableConfigKeys.description: Key that moves to the line's first non-blank column, then switches to INSERT — vim's `I`.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Join lines
overridableConfigKeys.description: Key that joins the current line with the line(s) below; a count above 1 joins that many lines.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Captured keys per mode
overridableConfigKeys.description: The declared key set the host's keyboard router reads synchronously to decide preventDefault, keyed by this trait's current state name. A key not listed reaches the underlying textarea untouched. Keep in sync with the other knobs.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Motion keys
overridableConfigKeys.description: Keys recognized in NORMAL, VISUAL and OPERATOR_PENDING, mapped to the closed motion vocabulary the editor surface understands.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Open a line above and insert
overridableConfigKeys.description: Key that moves to line start, inserts a newline, then moves up and switches to INSERT — vim's `O`.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: open line above, new line above

overridableConfigKeys.label: Open a line below and insert
overridableConfigKeys.description: Key that moves to line end (past the last char), inserts a newline, then switches to INSERT — vim's `o`.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Operator keys
overridableConfigKeys.description: Keys that arm OPERATOR_PENDING, mapped to the operator name carried on OPERATE. Pressing the same key again operates on the whole line.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: operators, delete, yank, change, indent, dedent

overridableConfigKeys.label: Put before caret
overridableConfigKeys.description: Key that pastes the last yank/delete before the caret. `motion` on OPERATE is a fixed `right` placeholder — this is a point operator and the editor ignores it.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Put after caret
overridableConfigKeys.description: Key that pastes the last yank/delete after the caret. `motion` on OPERATE is a fixed `right` placeholder — this is a point operator and the editor ignores it.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Redo (with Ctrl)
overridableConfigKeys.description: Held with Ctrl, redoes the last undone change. `motion` on OPERATE is a fixed `right` placeholder — this is a point operator and the editor ignores it. Shares its default key with replaceKey; the ctrl modifier disambiguates.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Repeat last change
overridableConfigKeys.description: Key that re-applies the last OPERATE (operator, motion, count) recorded from OPERATOR_PENDING or VISUAL. No-op until a change has been recorded.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Replace char
overridableConfigKeys.description: Without Ctrl, arms a one-key replace: the next non-Escape key overwrites the character under the caret. Shares its default key with redoKey; the ctrl modifier disambiguates.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Toggle case
overridableConfigKeys.description: Key that flips the case of the character under the caret, count times.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Undo
overridableConfigKeys.description: Key that undoes the last change. `motion` on OPERATE is a fixed `right` placeholder — this is a point operator and the editor ignores it.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Enter VISUAL
overridableConfigKeys.description: Key that switches NORMAL to VISUAL; motions then extend the selection and an operator acts on it.
